title: · Inside View | CINDY CHAO Fine Art Jewellery Unveils New Exhibition at Its Shanghai "Heart Residence": Encounters with the Master's Spirit ·
original_title: 视野 | CINDY CHAO 艺术珠宝上海「心邸」新展揭幕：遇见大师精神
excerpt: CINDY CHAO will exhibit jewelry alongside Sean Scully paintings at its Shanghai space during the 2026 Shanghai Art Week.
author: 撰稿 X Zoey 编辑 X Vivi

blocks.text: From November 11 to 20, 2026, during the eighth Shanghai Art Week, the museum-caliber art jewelry brand CINDY CHAO will present a special exhibition at its Shanghai «Heart Residence» (Xin Di), pairing paintings by the renowned abstract artist Sean Scully with major creations by jewelry artist Cindy Chao. The exhibition invites visitors to encounter the spirit of a master within the artist's creative world and to feel the life force that art, at its most moving, can awaken.
CINDY CHAO Shanghai «Heart Residence» New Exhibition «Encountering the Master's Spirit»
· A Resonance of Color ·

One dissolves the figurative with pigment; the other builds volume with gemstones. Abstract art and jewelry art may seem to belong to two separate realms, yet they share a single preoccupation with color: color is never an isolated presence but a relationship continually generated among layers, light and shadow, material, and perception. Where the abstract painter sweeps color across the canvas, jewelry artist Cindy Chao layers gemstones to create color's structure and sense of space. It is precisely this profound resonance around color and artistic expression that brings Sean Scully's paintings across the ocean to «Heart Residence», making them the most fitting vehicle for a dialogue with the master's spirit.
Jewelry artist Cindy Chao (left) and abstract painter Sean Scully (right)

The exhibition takes as its point of departure the connections and resonances of color between the works of Sean Scully and Cindy Chao, with abstract paintings and art jewelry echoing one another within a single space. Through rhythmic color combinations and bands of line held in dynamic balance, Sean Scully captures hue, light, and emotion in a highly dramatic way. Standing before his work, the eye travels along the striking layers of color and discovers, in the details, a highly complex and captivating structure that conjures boundless associations with specific times and places. Color holds equal significance in Cindy Chao's creative world. She folds the painterly concept of «layered color» into her work, spreading hundreds or even thousands of gemstones of different tonal gradations and cuts across curved surfaces of extremely limited volume—at times placing near-extreme colors side by side until they fuse into an entirely new hue that exists on no palette at all, so that with every change of angle the viewer perceives subtle shifts in the piece. Several of the brand's signature creations in this exhibition fully embody this philosophy; moving among them, viewers find color blocks and gemstones, flatness and volume, resonating across media—an exploration of color and abstraction completed within a single arena.
Paintings by abstract artist Sean Scully and jewelry creations by jewelry artist Cindy Chao on view at CINDY CHAO Art Jewelry Shanghai «Heart Residence»
· The Creative Spirit of a Master ·

Throughout history, whatever the artistic period, aesthetic style, or mode of expression, the works of true masters tend to share one thing: the power to move the heart. What allows them to stir emotion and inspire thought is that the artist has poured a creative philosophy and soul into them. The capture and expression of emotion takes different forms in different artists, yet points to the same creative core.

Cindy Chao once said: «I hope that when a collector picks up my work many years from now, she can still feel that the leaf is turning in the wind, that the flower is suspended at the fullest moment of its life.» Each piece carries her lived experience and an emotion that cannot be replicated, allowing jewelry to transcend material and era and to retain a vibrant, enduring vitality.

Emotional investment often begins with the very first step of creation. Cindy Chao's jewelry work starts with wax sculpting, breaking with the industry tradition of beginning with a two-dimensional drawing; she has always given ideas physical form, making the intangible tangible. For her, the time-honored craft of wax sculpting has long surpassed craft itself to become the origin of artistic expression. Breaking form and crossing boundaries happen, in this way, quite naturally. When form truly serves emotion, a work ceases to be merely an object to be viewed and becomes a vessel in which the artist's spirit continues to grow.
CINDY CHAO Art Jewelry White Label High Jewelry Four Seasons Collection Maple Leaf Brooch, wax sculpting process image
· A Borderless Art Space ·

Cindy Chao continues to push boundaries along her artistic path, and «Heart Residence», the art jewelry appreciation space she built with her own hands, likewise embodies art's inclusiveness and generative power. This contemporary-art-style refresh of the space once again expresses her pursuit of «art without boundaries», bringing together art of different media, cultures, and eras to meet and coexist.

Since its founding, CINDY CHAO Art Jewelry has continually invited artists from different fields to gather here. In 2025, on the occasion of «Heart Residence»'s fifth anniversary, works by the renowned contemporary artist Carol Bove; artists Nathalie Djurberg and Hans Berg; Johan Creten, a pioneer of the modern ceramics revival; the young Chinese artist Ji Xin; and the Spanish artist Javier Calleja were exhibited here, using a «sculpture garden» that breaks through artistic boundaries to recompose contemporary art, spatial aesthetics, Eastern and Western cultures, and craft heritage in a way that resonates as one. In May 2026, Cindy Chao will extend her creative philosophy of «art is existence» from the microscopic world of jewelry to the entire space, taking the architectural logic of the Chinese garden as the narrative thread of the space and employing techniques such as borrowed scenery and framed views to create an Eastern atmosphere in which the scene shifts with every step—an in-depth artistic journey across East and West, connecting past and present…

«Heart Residence» thus becomes a unique artistic field, a platform for exchange and convergence where art of every kind can take place. Artist friends who have visited leave traces of their thought and creativity here, making the space akin to the European art salons that originated in the seventeenth century—a place where art can unfold freely, be discussed openly, and strike a chord in the soul. Every guest who visits is not merely a connoisseur but a participant in this continually growing artistic ecosystem.
